name: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association

summary.text: The Billy Graham Evangelistic Association was formed in 1950 after Atlanta newspapers printed photographs of money bags from a crusade 'love offering'; Graham assembled a board of businessmen, put himself and his staff on salary and routed crusade collections to local committees. The Philanthropy Roundtable lists the BGEA among the evangelical bodies J. Howard Pew supported.

sources.title: Billy Graham made sure integrity was never in question

facts.claim: The New Georgia Encyclopedia dates the BGEA's founding to 1950; RNS says Graham formed a board of businessmen and took a fixed salary after the Atlanta love-offering photographs.
facts.quote: assembled a board of businessmen to oversee his ministry and put himself and his staff on salary

openQuestions: Amounts of Pew's BGEA support were not found. A 2018 blog reports the BGEA later changed its IRS status to a church and stopped filing public 990s; this needs confirmation from ProPublica's Nonprofit Explorer.
